business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Urban Electric Cargo Bicycles and Step-Through Scooters

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Marshall Islands (unitary national jurisdiction with no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: common-law doctrinal foundation (corporate statutes modeled on Delaware General Corporation Law and U.S. federal statutory framing) overlaid with constitutional and customary law; unitary national legal system
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States of America (1986, as amended 2003)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER Plus), in force for the RMI since 2020
African, Caribbean and Pacific (ACP)-European Union Partnership (Cotonou successor framework applied provisionally to the RMI)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Act 2012 (as amended); Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism (Prescribed Transactions and Reporting) Regulations 2013; Companies (Beneficial Ownership Information) Regulations 2021; Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended); Non-Resident Domestic Corporations Act 1990 (as amended); Marshall Islands Banking Act 1991 (as amended); Insurance Act 1995 (as amended)
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access: Beneficial ownership information must be filed with the licensed registered agent and the Registrar of Corporations and is accessible to RMI competent authorities and foreign regulators upon lawful request; the register is not publicly searchable. Nominee shareholders and nominee directors are permitted, but the nominee arrangement and the underlying beneficial owner must be disclosed to the registered agent and Registrar.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille Certification (RMI Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency listing directors, officers, and registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by RMI notary public followed by Hague Apostille Certification

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolutions approving pre-incorporation subscriptions and authorized signatories

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille Certification

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, officers, UBOs, and material counterparties against (i) the PEP definition under the RMI Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Act 2012, (ii) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Consolidated Non-SDN lists, (iii) UN Security Council consolidated sanctions lists under Resolutions 1267/1988/2253 (ISIL/al-Qaida), 2231 (Iran), and 1718 (DPRK), (iv) EU and UK consolidated financial sanctions lists, and (v) FATF public statements and the RMI Ministerial prescribed list of high-risk and non-cooperative jurisdictions; any positive match triggers enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds verification, and a suspicious transaction report to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Justice, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro); administrative intake processed exclusively through licensed registered agents, including the Association of Marshall Islands registered-agent network (official e-filing via licensed agent channels; no direct public registry portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Business names must be expressed in Latin-script English characters; the official corporate record is kept in English. Names in Marshallese (Kajin Majeļ) or other languages may be registered in romanized transliteration, and a transliteration certificate is required for non-Latin-script names. No translation requirement applies to English-language names; the registered name must be distinguishable from all existing corporations, trade names, and reserved marks on the Registrar's consolidated index.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation is valid for 180 days and may be renewed for successive additional 180-day periods upon payment of the Registrar's extension fee, provided no conflicting application is pending at renewal. Upon rejection of a proposed name, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Corporations within 30 days of the rejection notice, setting out the grounds of distinctiveness and attaching written consent letters from the holders of any identical or confusingly similar names; the Registrar must issue a determination within 15 working days. A further appeal lies to the High Court of the Marshall Islands under the Business Corporations Act 1990, and the court may order registration of the name if the Registrar's refusal was arbitrary, discriminatory, or contrary to the Act.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A purely virtual (non-physical) office is not recognized in the Marshall Islands. Every business corporation must maintain a physical registered office and a licensed registered agent within the Republic, and the registered office must accept service of process during ordinary business hours. For a non-resident micro-mobility OEM holding company, the licensed agent's physical address satisfies the statutory registered-office requirement; no domestic premises, employees, warehouse, or factory footprint is required. Virtual directorship and remote shareholding are permissible provided executed consents and UBO declarations are held by the registered agent.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: approximately 3-5% probability of an unannounced physical inspection over a three-year horizon for a low-risk, non-resident manufacturing holding corporation with no domestic wage, customs, banking, or insurance footprint. The Registrar and licensed agents predominantly conduct desk-based compliance file audits; on-site inspections are generally reserved for entities engaging in domestic physical operations, licensed financial activity, or ship-owning activities under the RMI Maritime Administrator.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990 (BCCA) of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, as amended, Sections 19-45 (formation, registered office and agent, first board of directors); Part VI (directors and officers); Section 122 (non-resident tax exemption provisions under the Income Tax Act).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Commercial and Corporate Affairs Registry, Ministry of Justice and Immigration, Republic of the Marshall Islands.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (standard form adopted pursuant to BCCA Section 23).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum authorized or paid-up capital is required under the BCCA. The Articles of Incorporation may authorize shares with or without par value, and shares may be issued for lawful consideration of at least USD 1.00 per share. No escrow account or capital deposit is mandated for a non-resident business corporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Articles of Incorporation filed with the Registrar of Corporations are approved and adopted, and the share subscriptions reflected therein are hereby accepted and allocated among the founding shareholders in accordance with applicable law. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Corporation is established at the licensed registered agent's address in Majuro, Marshall Islands, and the initial registered agent is confirmed. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the following officers are appointed: President, Secretary, and Treasurer, each to serve until the next annual meeting and until successors are duly elected. The President is authorized and directed to execute all statutory filings, banking documents, and business license applications required for the Corporation's formation and commencement of operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Commercial and Corporate Affairs Registry, Ministry of Justice and Immigration (Majuro, RMI).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a formal name reservation request through a licensed RMI registered agent. The request must specify the proposed corporate name (including a corporate suffix such as 'Inc.' or 'Corp.'), state the purpose of manufacturing electric cargo bicycles under ISIC 3091, and identify the proposed registered office in Majuro. The Registrar will search the corporate names index and, if available, reserve the name for an initial term of 120 days, renewable once.
required_dossiers: Engagement letter from a licensed RMI registered agent
Draft Articles of Incorporation (purpose and capital summary)
List of proposed directors and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused on grounds of similarity, misleading character, or prohibited terms, submit a revised request containing up to three alternate names; the Registrar shall re-adjudicate within two business days at no additional government fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution, and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (RMI or foreign notary with apostille/consular legalization) and the appointed RMI registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation compliant with BCCA Section 23, including the corporate name, registered office address in Majuro, name and address of the registered agent, authorized capital structure (e.g., 1,000 shares at USD 1.00 par value or no-par shares), permitted business purpose, and optional provisions limiting director liability. Execute the document before a notary public, obtain the notarial certificate and apostille if executed outside the RMI, and transmit the notarized original to the registered agent for countersignature and filing.
required_dossiers: Executed and notarized Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Articles contain an irregularity, the incorporators may sign a corrigendum or amended Articles and re-file within five business days; re-notarization is not required for correction of manifest typographical errors if the original notarized signature remains valid.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing, Fee Payment, and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations and the RMI central payments facility accessed through the licensed registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Transmit the executed Articles of Incorporation, Form RA-1, and the official filing fee to the Registrar of Corporations. Upon acceptance and validation of the filing, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the seal of the Republic of the Marshall Islands. The certificate date constitutes the effective date of incorporation, and the corporation becomes a separate legal entity with limited liability.
required_dossiers: Evidence of payment of the USD 250 government filing fee and service fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query for deficient fees, missing signatures, or non-compliant purpose clauses, cure by filing a supplementary Form COR-9 and paying the outstanding balance within three business days; the original filing priority is preserved upon cure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Agent Endorsement and Certificate of Good Standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed RMI registered agent and Registrar of Corporations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Certificate of Incorporation is issued, the registered agent executes the endorsement confirming acceptance of service of process and the registered office address. Concurrently, apply to the Registrar for a Certificate of Good Standing to confirm that the corporation has no outstanding filings, annual report delinquencies, or unpaid fees.
required_dossiers: Application for Certificate of Good Standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Good Standing reflects outstanding annual report liabilities, pay all arrears and submit a clearance request within five business days; the Registrar will update the corporate ledger and reissue the certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting, Adoption of Bylaws, and First Board Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Marshall Islands Business Corporation (internal corporate action governed by BCCA Sections 42-44).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the organizational meeting by written unanimous consent or physical meeting. Adopt the corporate bylaws, approve the issuance of shares to subscribing shareholders, ratify the registered office and registered agent, elect the initial board of directors, and appoint the President, Secretary, and Treasurer. Execute the pro-forma First Board Resolution and record it in the corporate minute book with the share ledger and director/officer register.
required_dossiers: Waiver of notice signed by all incorporators or shareholders
Share subscription statements and share ledger schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If unanimous written consent cannot be obtained, call an organizational meeting on five days' written notice; any defect in notice is waived by attending shareholders in writing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Non-Resident Tax Exemption Attestation and Industrial License Pre-Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RMI Revenue and Taxation Office; RMI Environmental Protection Authority; Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Trade.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Certificate of Incorporation together with an attestation of non-resident status and a statement that the corporation will not carry on a trade or business within the RMI, thereby preserving the statutory tax exemption on foreign-source income. Simultaneously submit pre-application forms to the RMI EPA for environmental classification and to the Business License Office for the manufacturing business license, including the factory site zoning certificate.
required_dossiers: Non-resident activity attestation and affidavit of foreign principal office address
Municipal zoning clearance for the proposed factory site
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax exemption attestation is queried for insufficient proof of non-resident activity, submit supplementary affidavits and bank records within fifteen days. If the municipal zoning clearance is denied, apply to the Majuro Planning Office for a special-use permit or identify an alternative zoned industrial site.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Trade – Business License Office; RMI Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business License – Manufacturing (ISIC 3091), issued under the Business License Act 2019.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Republic of the Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA), established under the Environmental Protection Act 1984.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B – Preliminary Environmental Assessment and Standard Operating Permit (EIA registration level). A Full Environmental Impact Assessment Report is waived unless the facility sits within a protected watershed, marine conservation area, or within 50 meters of a residential boundary.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Effluent standards: pH 6.0-9.0; BOD5 ≤ 30 mg/L; TSS ≤ 50 mg/L; total petroleum hydrocarbons ≤ 10 mg/L; no visible oil sheen. Air emissions: VOC stack concentration < 50 ppm; coating materials must not exceed 250 g/L VOC; welding fume and airborne battery dust controlled by local exhaust ventilation to NIOSH/ACGIH threshold limit values. Spent lithium-ion batteries are classified as hazardous waste, must be stored under secondary containment, and may only be exported to a certified recycler under a Basel Convention waste manifest.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Majuro Fire Department under the National Fire Safety Code, including automatic fire suppression and fire-rated separation for lithium battery storage, paint booths, and welding bays; Structural load certification from the Municipal Planning Office verifying floor load capacity for machinery and battery stores; Occupational Safety and Health inspection clearance from the Ministry of Health and Human Services covering ventilation, eyewash stations, emergency egress, and personal protective equipment programs.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Taxation Administration (RTA), Ministry of Finance, Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands; official portal: rta.mh (Marshall Islands Revenue and Taxation Administration online services).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a non-resident Business Corporation (BC), the statutory TIN-equivalent is not required because such entities are exempt from domestic income tax. Procedure: (1) Incorporate the BC with the Office of the Registrar of Corporations under the Associations Law of 1990, filing Articles of Incorporation and a registered agent appointment; (2) file the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation status election with the Registrar, designating the entity as a foreign-owned non-resident BC; (3) obtain the Certificate of Exemption issued by the RTA confirming immunity from Marshall Islands income and withholding taxes for 20 years; (4) maintain annual government franchise fee payments and registered agent renewal filings. No RTA tax identification number is issued or required unless the BC later derives Marshall Islands-source income, employs residents in-country, or engages in regulated local activity.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box or entity classification election exists. A BC may elect Non-Resident Domestic Corporation status under the Associations Law to obtain the statutory 20-year tax exemption certificate. No hybrid mismatch elections are available; the Marshall Islands has no comprehensive income tax treaty network and does not apply hybrid mismatch rules. An entity could alternatively elect to be taxed as an ordinary resident domestic corporation under the Income Tax Act 1989, but this is not beneficial and is rarely exercised.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None - the Marshall Islands imposes no VAT, GST, or Sales and Use Tax; indirect taxation is limited to customs import duties levied under the Customs and Excise Act.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable; there is no VAT/GST/sales tax regime and therefore no turnover-based registration threshold. Customs import duty is applied transactionally per-consignment on the c.i.f. value of goods entering Majuro or Kwajalein ports.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API reporting, or digital stamping mandate exists in the Marshall Islands. Commercial invoices are issued in free-format PDF/paper and are not pre-cleared by the RTA; customs declarations are submitted to the Marshall Islands Customs Service on standard export/import forms.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable: there is no VAT system in force, so no export zero-rating or VAT refund mechanism exists. Export sales of electric cargo e-bikes by a non-resident BC are wholly outside the Marshall Islands tax net; the exemption certificate removes all local taxation on offshore manufacturing, trading, and export revenue. The exporter should nevertheless maintain documented evidence of foreign destination to confirm non-resident status and avoid any Marshall Islands-source characterization.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Marshall Islands Customs Service export form)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing foreign consignee and non-resident destination
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing receipt of export sale proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Although no VAT clawback exists, the RTA and Customs Service apply anti-abuse measures: fraudulent export declarations or misrepresentation of the non-resident status can result in revocation of the tax exemption certificate, retroactive income tax assessment for up to five years, monetary penalties up to 10% per year on underpaid amounts, customs fines up to three times the evaded duty, seizure of goods, and criminal liability for officers in cases of intentional customs fraud.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) has no central bank and no dedicated foreign exchange administration. Prudential licensing and supervision of banks is vested in the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, pursuant to the Banking Act 1987 (as amended). The Marshall Islands Financial Services Commission (FISC), established under the Financial Services Commission Act 2020, supervises non-bank financial service providers and trust/company agents. The de facto monetary anchor is the United States Federal Reserve, as the US Dollar is the sole official legal tender of the RMI under the Compact of Free Association.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The USD is legal tender, and the RMI, as an IMF Article VIII member, maintains no exchange restrictions on current or capital international transactions. There is no statutory approval process for capital inflows, profit repatriation, dividend distribution, interest payments, or liquidation proceeds to non-residents. The capital account is fully open, and the RMI tax code imposes no income, withholding, or remittance taxes on the non-resident Business Corporation (tax-exempt statutory status). The only practical friction is documentary: US correspondent banks and RMI licensed banks will apply OFAC screening, FATF-style beneficial ownership verification, and a substantive 'economic purpose' review of each credit/debit flow.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None imposed. There is no statutory timeline for surrender or repatriation of export proceeds, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no obligation to deposit receivables with an RMI domestic bank. However, under the RMI AML/CFT framework (including the 2018 Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act), the BC must retain contemporaneous documentary evidence attaching each inbound trade credit to a genuine underlying sale: commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, ISIC 3091 / NAICS 336991 alignment, and the executed purchase order from the foreign distributor or OEM client.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Marshall Islands (BMI), Majuro Head Office
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Multi-Currency USD Account
Operational USD Account with US Routing Number (ABA 121400092 via Guam)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW. Mainstream digital EMI platforms (Wise, Airwallex, Mercury, Revolut Business, Payoneer) typically reject RMI Business Corporations at automated onboarding due to the jurisdiction being tagged as an offshore/financial-secrecy jurisdiction and the absence of an RMI central bank to satisfy EMIs' 'regulated financial institution' checks. A viable alternative is a USD account with Bank of Guam (access to the US domestic ACH/fedwire system) followed by a Payoneer or Bloomberg-backed receiving-only arrangement where the fintech is not the primary settlement rail. Legal constraint: any EMI that onboards an RMI BC must itself demonstrate correspondent AML equivalence; the RMI's non-participation in the US state money-transmitter licensing framework makes this commercially rare.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For Bank of Marshall Islands, physical attendance of at least one director (or a local RMI-licensed nominee/authorized signatory) at the Majuro branch is effectively mandatory for account opening and original signature verification; remote opening is not available. For Bank of Guam Majuro, the bank may permit a hybrid remote process with notarized/apostilled corporate documents, a certified passport copy, and a live video-call KYC interview, but it retains discretion to require an in-person visit on a 'physical-equivalent' basis. All Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs) with 10% or more economic interest must provide certified identity documents and complete a source-of-wealth questionnaire. A corporate board resolution designating authorized signatories must be apostilled under the Hague Convention and accompanied by a Certificate of Good Standing issued by the RMI Registrar of Corporations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore shell suspicion: 100% non-resident ownership, nominee shareholder arrangements, no local physical premises, and banking from a 'tax-haven' domicile (RMI corporate registry profile).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing; RMI registered-agent license certificate; full organizational chart tracing to natural-person UBOs with passport notarization; an economic-substance narrative and supporting financials demonstrating that the BC is the procurement/manufacturing-contract principal for an electric cargo e-bike facility in the sovereign production country (e.g., China or Vietnam); executed OEM manufacturing agreement, supply contracts, and a warehouse/production lease in the entity's name.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Industry classification mismatch: the bank's transaction-monitoring flags coded as 'general trading' or 'financial holding' rather than ISIC 3091 / NAICS 336991, causing invoice-vs-activity mismatches.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide HS/HTS harmonized codes for electric cargo bicycles (HS 8711.60) and key components (lithium-ion batteries HS 8507.60, controllers, motors), customs import/export records, bill-of-lading samples, ISO 9001 and CE/EN 15194 conformity certificates, and a one-page product-line specification sheet to anchor the coding accurately in the bank's economic profiling engine.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Funds-sourcing opacity for the initial capital injection: shareholder wealth originating from countries with high AML risk, or capital routed indirectly from an unnamed trust.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank reference from the shareholder's homebank; 12-month shareholder bank statements; audited or management financial statements of the investing parent; source-of-wealth summary (sale-of-company deed, dividend distributions, accumulated salary) with corroborating notarized certificates; board resolution authorizing equity injection; an indemnity/declaration confirming no third-party funding of the subscription without disclosure.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: (1) pass an MH_BC board resolution approving equity subscription and expressly designating the receiving account (Bank of Guam Majuro USD account, or Bank of Marshall Islands USD account); (2) remit in USD via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's homebank directly to the RMI bank's correspondent — for Bank of Guam use its US ABA routing number and the beneficiary account with RMI company name and reference: 'EQ SUB MH_BC [date]'; (3) if the shareholder is not US-based, use a CHIPS-participant intermediary with a full 20-digit beneficiary account number and the RMI company's registered address to prevent OpRisk fails; (4) the payment purpose code should align with BPM6 category 'equity investment' / capital contribution; RMI requires no exchange-control permit or prior approval; (5) corroborate the booking with the bank's credit advice and deposit a signed subscription statement and updated share register into the corporate treasury file for future AML reviews.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail: SWIFT MT103 (T/T) for component supplier settlements (battery packs, motors, controllers, frame parts, tyres) directly from the USD account; each MT103 must include full beneficiary legal name, account, BIC/IBAN, and, for Chinese beneficiaries, the 11-digit CNAPS code. Secondary rail: Commercial Irrevocable Letter of Credit (at-sight) opened by Bank of Guam or BMI in favour of the supplier's bank for high-value OEM batch purchases (typically above USD 2,000,000); documents must include commercial invoice, full-set clean on-board bill of lading, packing list, certificate of origin and, where required, HS 8711.60 declaration. For suppliers requiring accelerated payment, use TT 30% advance / 70% against documents. Prohibited practice: accumulating CNY or EUR balances onshore in the RMI entity — always settle in USD and let the beneficiary's bank perform the cross-currency conversion.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/CNY Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) traded offshore (e.g., Singapore/Hong Kong level-1 bank treasury desk) — permissible because the RMI imposes no derivatives licensing or exchange-control restrictions on a non-resident BC; documented under English-law ISDA 2002.

Deliverable FX forwards (USD/EUR, USD/TWD, USD/KRW) with Bank of Guam or the maintaining bank's treasury desk under an approved FX line — permitted as bona fide hedging of known trade payables/receivables and excluded from speculative dealing by the BC's investment policy.

Cross-currency swaps (USD/CNY, USD/VND) under an ISDA 2002 master agreement with a CSA segregated account at Bank of Guam — permissible for hedging long-term OEM supplier financing; the swap must be designated as a cash-flow hedge under IFRS 9 with contemporaneous hedge documentation to preserve auditability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and Franchise Tax Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Business Entities Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 30 June, regardless of incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid franchise tax accrues statutory interest and late-payment penalties; after one missed annual filing cycle, the Registrar may issue a default notice and, if the default is not cured within the applicable cure period, administratively strike off or dissolve the corporation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Annual Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed registered agent acting for the Marshall Islands Registrar; confirmation is processed as part of the annual report cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be current by 30 June each year and updated within 30 days after any change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain the required registered agent and registered office is a continuing statutory violation; the Registrar may issue a notice of non-compliance and ultimately invoke administrative strike-off if the default remains uncured.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership and Share Register Annual Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed registered agent; confidential register maintained at the registered office and made available to designated authorities upon lawful request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after any share transfer or beneficial ownership change; annual confirmation by 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Deficiencies in beneficial ownership record-keeping may be reported by the registered agent to the AML/CFT authority and may attract regulatory fines; continuous non-compliance can support Registrar strike-off proceedings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit threshold applies to a non-resident business corporation; an audit is required only where imposed by the articles, a shareholder agreement, a financing covenant, a regulator, or an order of the Registrar or court in connection with a books-and-records investigation.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory local accounting framework; acceptable practice permits application of IFRS, US GAAP, or another consistently applied comprehensive basis of accounting, provided underlying records are maintained.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Marshall Islands law does not impose a public UBO filing; however, under AML/CFT rules, the registered agent must identify and maintain current beneficial ownership information. Any transfer of shares changing beneficial ownership or control must be notified to the registered agent and recorded in the register within 30 days, with a formal annual refresh performed during the 30 June maintenance cycle.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$1,500–US$4,000 per engagement if an audit is voluntarily or contractually required

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% applicable corporate income tax rate for a non-resident Business Corporation; the Marshall Islands Income Tax Act (26 MIRC Ch.1) taxes only income derived from sources within the Republic, and a non-resident corporation without RMI-source income owes no corporate income tax.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Foreign-source income of non-resident corporations is expressly exempt (26 MIRC sec. 121); no capital gains tax; no alternative minimum tax; no branch remittance tax; no VAT or GST. A 3% Gross Revenue Tax applies only to persons actively engaged in trade or business within the RMI territory, which an offshore OEM manufacturer of electric cargo e-bikes (ISIC 3091) avoids by maintaining no local sales office, warehouse, or employees in the Republic.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: BCA sec. 72 Annual Report of Domestic Corporation — filed with the RMI Registrar of Corporations through its electronic registration portal or via a licensed registered agent in Majuro.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the thirtieth day preceding the anniversary of incorporation; a USD 200 delinquency fee applies to late filings, and failure to file for two consecutive years permits administrative strike-off.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact corporate name and registration number as stated in the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the full legal name and company registration number; do not abbreviate the RMI corporate suffix.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent in the Republic of the Marshall Islands, including name and RMI street address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the licensed registered agent of record; the agent is the principal statutory contact for service of process.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: List of directors and officers with full names, nationalities, and residential addresses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; no local residency or nationality requirement applies to this entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital and issued and outstanding shares by class, including any changes during the reporting year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital requirement; disclose any share transfers, redemptions, or capital increases.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-resident tax status declaration confirming that the corporation has no RMI-source income and conducts no taxable activity in the Republic.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mark 'Exempt - no RMI-source income' and do not indicate any RMI employees or local premises; a false declaration triggers statutory penalty provisions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: USD 200 delinquency penalty in addition to the USD 200 annual fee. Persistent non-filing: administrative dissolution by the Registrar, loss of corporate powers, and incapacity to enforce contracts while dissolved.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Employer Quarterly Withholding Tax Return (wage tax and social security) — filed with the RMI Tax Division, Ministry of Finance, only if the corporation employs natural persons performing services within the Republic.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 days after the close of each calendar quarter; a nil return must be filed as long as any RMI employment relationship exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Employer name and RMI taxpayer identification number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter 'N/A - no RMI payroll' when no employees work in the Republic; do not obtain an RMI TIN for an offshore-only manufacturer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total wages paid for services performed within the RMI territory.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert zero and attach a one-line statement that no RMI-source wages were paid during the quarter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Eight percent income tax withheld and six percent social security contributions, employer and employee shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Leave blank with the notation 'No RMI employees' to avoid creating a local payroll nexus.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Default penalty of 10% per month on unpaid wage tax plus interest under 26 MIRC; criminal prosecution for wilful non-filing. This is the only income-related filing that could apply to the non-resident manufacturer, and only if it hires local staff.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - the RMI imposes no dividend withholding tax on distributions by a domestic business corporation to non-resident shareholders; dividends paid to a non-resident owner are foreign-source income exempt under 26 MIRC sec. 121.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable in practice - the Republic of the Marshall Islands has no comprehensive double taxation agreements; only Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) are in force. No treaty-relief claim form or tax residence certificate exists for non-resident corporations. The zero-rate dividend treatment is self-executing; the company must retain board minutes authorising each dividend and a shareholder non-resident declaration in its statutory records to evidence the exemption.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% for interest and royalties paid by a non-resident RMI business corporation to foreign lenders, licensors, or intellectual property holders because no RMI-source character attaches when the payor has no trade or business in the Republic. Treaty rate: none applicable (no DTAs in force).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory threshold and no Local File or Master File requirement - the RMI Income Tax Act does not codify transfer-pricing documentation rules, and the non-resident manufacturer sits outside the RMI tax base. Best practice for bank financing and group consolidation: prepare a one-page intercompany pricing memorandum evidencing an arm's length OEM margin (e.g., TNMM operating margin benchmark of 5-10%) although no RMI filing obligation is triggered.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI Economic Substance Regulations Act 2019 applies to non-resident domestic corporations conducting 'relevant activities' - banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, pure holding, distribution and service centre, and intellectual property holding. Manufacture of electric cargo bicycles and step-through scooters (ISIC 3091) is not a listed relevant activity and therefore falls outside the annual ESR notification and substance-testing regime. However, if the RMI entity additionally performs group distribution or procurement agency functions for parts and finished e-bikes, the distribution-and-service-centre category may be triggered, requiring local physical presence or outsourced substance and an annual ESR notification.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / False Tax Exemption Declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing the annual report with a declaration of 'no RMI-source income' while officers in fact conduct retail sales, warehousing, or payroll inside the Marshall Islands, or while the corporation holds a 3% Gross Revenue Tax registration for local business operations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under 26 MIRC: a 20% delinquency penalty plus monthly interest on underpaid tax, increasing to 50% for fraudulent intent; the Tax Division may issue a jeopardy assessment and freeze bank accounts; a criminal conviction for wilful evasion carries a fine of up to USD 10,000 and imprisonment of up to 5 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: RMI courts pierce the corporate veil where the exemption declaration is a sham; directors who sign a false report are personally liable for unpaid corporate tax and penalties, may face criminal prosecution, and can be barred from leaving the jurisdiction pending a tax investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the RMI business corporation as a letterbox entity with no commercial activity, no genuine board decisions, and no bank account history, while using tax-exempt status to shield undisclosed beneficial owners; or carrying on an ESR-relevant activity (distribution, financing, IP holding) without substance and without filing the annual ESR notification.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the BCA 1990: administrative dissolution, revocation of the certificate of good standing, a USD 200 late-report penalty, and a deregistration flag in the RMI corporate registry; under the ESR regime: a fixed civil penalty of up to USD 10,000 plus USD 5,000 per month for continuing non-compliance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who continue trading while the company is struck off are jointly and severally liable for all new debts; the court may order civil restitution, impose a travel ban, and disqualify a director from serving on the board of any RMI-registered entity for up to 3 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the e-bike OEM entity to launder funds through inflated import invoices for batteries and components, over-invoicing or under-invoicing finished e-bike sales, or channelling commission payments to offshore accounts; failing to maintain beneficial-ownership records under the RMI AML framework; accepting cash or opaque third-party payments outside the documented low-risk trade pattern.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under RMI anti-money laundering and counter-financing of terrorism legislation: fines up to USD 25,000 per infraction, forfeiture of the transaction value, and imprisonment of up to 5 years for natural persons; the Financial Intelligence Unit may freeze corporate bank accounts pending investigation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve or remain wilfully blind to anomalous trade invoices face personal criminal money-laundering charges, asset forfeiture, referral to the US Office of Foreign Assets Control for USD-denominated transactions, and a court-issued travel ban pending extradition or confiscation proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Shipping electric cargo bicycles or lithium-ion battery packs to embargoed end-users or through transshipment routes that evade UN, US, or EU export controls; misdeclaring the bill of lading or country of origin on the RMI trade route to reduce customs duty or circumvent a sanctions designation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under RMI customs and sanctions enforcement: seizure and forfeiture of the cargo, administrative fines up to USD 500,000, suspension of the corporate trading certificate, and referral to OFAC for USD-settlement accounts; repeat offences trigger cancellation of the company's registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers can be held personally and criminally liable for export-control breaches, subjected to arrest and extradition from the Pacific region, personal asset freezing, and a travel ban issued by the RMI High Court pending trial.
